templates.description: Raw acoustic blues palette: resonator slide guitar, voice and harmonica, with optional upright bass and foot-stomp percussion.
templates.treatment: Shuffle and straight 12-bar variants, bottleneck slides and bends, call-and-response between voice and harmonica, free-time turnarounds.

templates.description: Amplified post-war electric blues band: lead and rhythm electric guitars, amplified harmonica, bass, drums and piano or organ.
templates.treatment: Classic turnarounds, bent notes and vibrato in the lead guitar, cupped-and-amplified harmonica lines, shuffle drums.

templates.description: Jumping small-band blues with a riffing horn section over boogie piano, guitar, upright bass and swinging drums.
templates.treatment: Swing/shuffle feel, unison and harmonised horn riffs, boogie-woogie piano left hand, honking tenor solos.

templates.description: Classic ragtime piano split across two hands for easy editing, with optional honky-tonk piano and banjo colours for saloon or silent-film scenes.
templates.treatment: Syncopated right-hand figures over an oom-pah march bass in the left hand; strict tempo, multi-strain forms (AABBACCDD).

templates.description: Early jazz front line of cornet, clarinet and trombone over tuba, banjo, piano and drums. Roles follow collective improvisation: lead, obbligato and tailgate.
templates.treatment: Cornet carries the lead, clarinet weaves obbligato above, trombone tailgate glissandi below; tuba two-beat bass and chunking banjo.

templates.description: A full swing-era big band: five saxes, trumpet and trombone sections, and a four-piece rhythm section with four-to-the-bar guitar.
templates.treatment: Section voicings (sax soli, brass shout choruses), swing eighths, falls and doits on phrase ends, call-and-response between sections.

templates.description: Fast small-group bebop quintet: alto sax, tenor sax and trumpet front line with piano, upright bass and drums.
templates.treatment: Rapid ii–V lines with altered dominants, unison heads, comping piano, ride-cymbal time with bass-drum 'bombs'.

templates.description: Relaxed, spacious cool jazz: sax, trumpet or flugelhorn, piano, bass and brushed drums, with optional chamber winds (flute, horn, bass clarinet).
templates.treatment: Spacious, open voicings and light vibrato; contrapuntal horn lines; soft dynamics with brushes; chamber winds for tone colour.

templates.description: Horn-led quintet with gospel and blues roots: tenor sax and trumpet over piano or Hammond organ, bass and drums.
templates.treatment: Blues- and gospel-inflected harmony, call-and-response horn riffs, organ swells with rotary speaker, backbeat-leaning swing.

templates.description: Modal small group: tenor sax and trumpet over piano, bass and drums, built for long modal vamps rather than fast changes.
templates.treatment: Extended single-mode vamps, quartal piano voicings, pedal-point bass, open drumming that builds intensity over long forms.

templates.description: Afro-Cuban jazz ensemble: trumpet, trombone and sax over piano montuno, tumbao bass, congas, timbales, bongos and clave. The clave track anchors the grid.
templates.treatment: Clave-aware rhythmic and harmonic grid (2-3 or 3-2), piano montunos, tumbao bass anticipations, cascara on timbales, tight horn mambo riffs.

templates.description: Electric jazz-rock: electric piano, analog synths, electric guitar, electric/fretless bass and drums, ready for odd meters.
templates.treatment: Complex meters (7/8, 5/4, 11/8 sections), extended and slash-chord harmony, unison synth/guitar lines, busy but tight drumming.

templates.description: Lush, laid-back neo-soul and contemporary jazz: Rhodes-style keys, bass, drums, clean guitar and a small horn section.
templates.treatment: Rich 9th/11th/13th extensions, behind-the-beat pocket, ghost-note drums, soft horn pads and unison hits.

templates.description: Fifties rock & roll combo: electric guitar, upright or electric bass, drums, pounding piano and honking tenor sax.
templates.treatment: Hard backbeat on 2 and 4, boogie bass lines, piano triplets and glissandi, sax honks and guitar double-stop licks.

templates.description: Classic rock four-piece plus organ: rhythm and lead electric guitars, bass, acoustic drums and Hammond, with optional acoustic guitar.
templates.treatment: Riff-based writing, power chords and open-chord rhythm parts, bent-note solos, Hammond swells and fills.

templates.description: Seventies progressive rock: guitars, bass and drums with analog synth lead, polysynth, organ and a tape-string pad, for long, multi-section forms.
templates.treatment: Odd meters (7/8, 5/4, 9/8) and metric modulation, long-form suites, unison keyboard/guitar runs, 12-string arpeggio interludes.

templates.description: Raw, fast punk and garage four-piece: two distorted guitars, bass and drums, with optional gang/shout vocals.
templates.treatment: Fast, direct downstroked power chords, eighth-note bass, straight driving drums, short songs and abrupt endings.

templates.description: Heavy rock and metal: double-tracked high-gain rhythm guitars, lead guitar, bass and a double-kick drum kit, with an optional synth pad.
templates.treatment: Palm-muted chugging riffs, double-kick patterns, tight guitar/bass unisons, tapped and bent leads.

templates.description: Nineties alternative and grunge: clean-to-distorted guitars, bass, drums and an ambient effects guitar layer.
templates.treatment: Strong dynamic contrast (quiet clean verses, loud distorted choruses), drop-tuned power chords, feedback and effects swells.

templates.description: Instrumental post-rock and indie: clean and delayed guitars, bass, drums and pads, with optional glockenspiel and strings for big crescendos.
templates.treatment: Long crescendos from near silence, interlocking delayed guitar arpeggios, evolving textures, tremolo-picked climaxes.

templates.description: Classic funk and soul band: drums, bass, scratch guitar, clavinet, Hammond and a three-piece horn section.
templates.treatment: Tight sixteenth-note pocket, emphasis on 'the one', muted scratch guitar, clavinet comping, horn stabs and unison lines.

templates.description: Seventies disco orchestra: four-on-the-floor drums, octave bass, rhythm guitar, keys, sweeping strings, horns and hand percussion.
templates.treatment: Four-on-the-floor kick with open hi-hat off-beats, octave-jumping bass, syncopated guitar chicken-scratch, string runs and stabs.

templates.description: Eighties synth-pop and new wave: analog polysynth, sequenced arpeggios, synth bass, drum machine, chorused guitar and a synth lead.
templates.treatment: Sequenced sixteenth-note arpeggios and bass lines, gated drum-machine snares, bright polysynth stabs, chorused clean guitar.

templates.description: Boom bap production palette: sample-style swung drums, bass, keys, turntable FX and a vinyl texture layer.
templates.treatment: Swung 16ths, hard snares on 2 and 4, 8- or 16-bar loop structures, chopped keys and scratch fills.

templates.description: Trap production palette: 808 bass, separate hats and snare/clap tracks, synth or keys melody, a bell layer and a dark pad.
templates.treatment: Half-time feel at high BPM, rapid hi-hat rolls and triplets, gliding 808s, sparse minor-key melodies.

templates.description: Slow-evolving ambient electronic palette: layered pads, granular texture, soft synth pulses and sub bass, with optional felt piano and delayed guitar.
templates.treatment: Slow evolution over long sections, filter and granular parameter drift, soft pulses, very sparse melodic material.

templates.description: Club-ready techno and house: drum machine, bass synth, stab chords, a sequencer line, pad and FX risers, all sync-locked.
templates.treatment: Four-on-the-floor kick, off-beat hats, sidechained bass and pads, 16-step sequencer patterns, filter automation over long builds.

templates.description: Drum & bass palette: chopped breakbeats, sub bass and a distorted mid-bass, atmospheric pads, a lead and FX.
templates.treatment: Fast syncopated breaks around 170–178 BPM, half-time pad and bass phrasing, reese-style detuned mid-bass, rolling ghost notes.

templates.description: Industrial and dark electronic production: distorted synths, metallic percussion, drum machine, noise and processed guitar.
templates.treatment: Heavy modulation and saturation, transient-designed metallic hits, gated noise, distorted guitar treated as texture rather than riffs.

templates.description: A sparse, dark hybrid palette in the spirit of industrial ambient tension and minimal electronic drama: felt piano, analog noise, sub bass, processed strings and sparse drums over an evolving drone.
templates.treatment: Evolving drone beds, irregular pulses that resist a steady grid, single felt-piano notes, processed string swells and isolated low hits.

templates.description: A contemporary film-score rig layering orchestra (strings, brass, piano) with synth textures, pulses, impacts and risers.
templates.treatment: Layered acoustic/electronic cues: string ostinati locked to synth pulses, brass swells, piano motifs, riser-into-impact transitions.

templates.description: Lo-fi chillhop palette: dusty swung kit, Rhodes-style keys, warm bass, sampled vinyl/tape textures and optional guitar and pad.
templates.treatment: Lazy swung 16ths, tape wobble and saturation, jazzy 7th/9th chords, vinyl crackle beds, short 4–8 bar loops.

templates.description: Modern pop and ballad palette: piano or guitar foundation, synth pads, bass and drums, with optional strings, backing vocals and a guide lead-vocal track.
templates.treatment: Hook-driven harmony around four-chord loops, verse-to-chorus lift in density, pad and string swells into the chorus.
